description: Create an unpaid eSIM order and get a payment link. Payment is always done by the human: give the user the payment link, never try to pay yourself and never ask for card details. Ask the user for their email first: the eSIM QR code is sent there. Creates a real order, so call it only after the user picked the plan.

email.description: The user's email for the receipt and the eSIM QR code

payment_method.description: Optional: sbp (Russian fast payments), card (Russian bank card), card_foreign (Visa/Mastercard issued abroad), crypto_usdt, crypto_ton. Omit to use the shop default.

name: create_order
